title: Ron Tototz and Parr, Nha Trang
description: A close, laughing snapshot from the first weeks in-country: Ron Tototz (left) — from Des Moines, Iowa, Larry says — and Parr (right), who held the same rank as Larry, probably PFC, and was at Nha Trang with him after they landed. Larry dates it September or October 1964, during the roughly two months when "they didn't know where to put us."
larrysRecollection:
Ron Tototz on left and Parr who was same rank as me, probably PFC. After we landed he was Nha Trang with me. 

Oct or Sept of 1964, we were there about 2 months, they didn't know where to put us

Ron was from Des Moines, Iowa
researchNotes: Larry's own account (Memories comments, 2026-08-15; archived as data/recollections/giscus-vn-0025-c18032311.json, -c18032317.json, and -c18032339.json). Corrects the survey's guess that the fair-haired man might be Larry — it is Parr. Two significant research gains: Ron's hometown (Des Moines, Iowa), which combined with his death about ten years ago (stories comment, same day) opens an obituary path to his real surname; and direct corroboration of the Nha Trang first-two-months timeline entry, with the added color that the new arrivals had no assignment yet.
